description_en: Queries the data sources added to a DataWorks workspace
description_zh: 该接口用于查询DataWorks的数据源列表
name: ListDataSources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the data sources belong. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据源所在的DataWorks工作空间ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html接口获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source that you want to query
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

odps
mysql
rds
oss
sqlserver
polardb
oracle
mongodb
emr
postgresql
analyticdb_for_mysql
hybriddb_for_postgresql
holo
parameters.help_zh:
数据源的类型。常用的类型如下：
odps
mysql
rds
oss
sqlserver
polardb
oracle
mongodb
emr
postgresql
analyticdb_for_mysql
hybriddb_for_postgresql
holo
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The subtype of the data source. This parameter takes effect only when the DataSourceType parameter is set to rds.

If the value of the DataSourceType parameter is rds, the value of this parameter can be mysql, sqlserver, or postgresql
parameters.help_zh:
数据源的子类型。仅当DataSourceType参数配置为RDS时，该参数生效。

当DataSourceType参数配置为RDS时，该参数可以配置为mysql、sqlserver或postgresql
parameters.name: sub_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the data source. Valid values:

ENABLED
DISABLED
parameters.help_zh:
数据源的状态。取值如下：
ENABLED，正常。
DISABLED，禁用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The environment in which the data source is used. Valid values: 0 and 1. The value 0 indicates development environment. The value 1 indicates production environment
parameters.help_zh: 数据源所属的环境，包括0（开发环境）和1（生产环境）
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大为100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的页码。取值为大于等于1的正整数
parameters.name: page_number

items.description_en: The information about the data source

BindingCalcEngineId.description_en: The ID of the compute engine with which the data source is associated
BindingCalcEngineId.description_zh: 数据源关联的计算引擎ID

ConnectStatus.description_en:
The status of the data source. Valid values:

1: The data source is accessible.
2: The data source is inaccessible
ConnectStatus.description_zh:
数据源的状态。取值如下：
1：表示数据源正常使用。
2：表示数据源已禁用

Content.description_en:
The data connection string. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format. Examples of connection strings of common data sources:

MaxCompute

        {
          "pubEndpoint": "http://service.cn.maxcompute.aliyun.com/api",
          "accessId": "xxxxxxx",
          "securityToken": null,
          "endpoint": "http://service.cn.maxcompute.aliyun-inc.com/api",
          "accessKey": "*",
          "name": "PRE_PROJECT_A_engine",
          "project": "PRE_PROJECT_A",
          "vpcEndpoint": "http://service.cn.maxcompute.aliyun-inc.com/api",
          "region": "cn-shanghai",
          "authType": "2"
        }

mysql

        {
          "configType": "1",
          "database": "mysql_d111b",
          "instanceName": "rm-xxxxxx",
          "password": "*",
          "rdsOwnerId": "12133xxxxxx",
          "tag": "rds",
          "username": "mysql_db111"
        }

sqlserver

        {
          "configType": "1",
          "jdbcUrl": "jdbc:sqlserver://rm-xxxxx.sqlserver.rds.aliyuncs.com:1433;DatabaseName=sqlserver_db1",
          "password": "*",
          "tag": "public",
          "username": "sqlserver_db111"
        }

oss

        {
          "accessId": "***********",
          "accessKey": "***********",
          "bucket": "bigxxx1223",
          "configType": "1",
          "endpoint": "http://oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com",
          "tag": "public"
        }

postgresql

        {
          "configType": "1",
          "database": "cdp_xxx",
          "instanceName": "rm-xxxx",
          "password": "*",
          "rdsOwnerId": "121xxxxx",
          "tag": "rds",
          "username": "cdp_xxx"
        }

ads

        {
          "configType": "1",
          "password": "*",
          "schema": "ads_demo",
          "tag": "public",
          "url": "ads-xxx-xxxx.cn-hangzhou-1.ads.aliyuncs.com:3029",
          "username": "lslslsls"
        }

DefaultEngine.description_en: Indicates whether the compute engine that is associated with the data source is the default compute engine used by data sources of the same type
DefaultEngine.description_zh: 数据源关联的引擎是否为同类型数据源选用的默认引擎

Description.description_en: The description of the data source

EnvType.description_en:
The environment in which the data source is used. Valid values:

0: development environment
1: production environment
EnvType.description_zh:
数据源所在的环境。取值如下：
0：开发环境。
1：生产环境

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the data source was created. Example: Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM
GmtCreate.description_zh: 创建数据源的时间。时间格式示例为Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the data source was last modified. Example: Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM
GmtModified.description_zh: 修改数据源的时间。时间格式示例为Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM

Name.description_en: The name of the data source

Operator.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to last modify the data source
Operator.description_zh: 最近一次修改数据源的阿里云用户ID

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the data source belongs
ProjectId.description_zh: 数据源关联的工作空间ID

Sequence.description_en: The sequence number of the data source. Data sources are sorted in descending order based on the value of this parameter
Sequence.description_zh: 排序字段。数据源按此字段从大到小排序

Shared.description_en: Indicates whether the data source is a shared data source

Status.description_en:
The status of the data source. Valid values:

1: The data source is accessible.
2: The data source is inaccessible
Status.description_zh:
数据源的状态。取值如下：
1：表示数据源正常使用。
2：表示数据源已禁用

SubType.description_zh: 数据源的子类型。仅当DataSourceType参数配置为RDS时，该参数生效

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of data sources

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
